verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an in-product Insights Agent that delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights from Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics. This is backed by AI Orchestrations, which analyze historical events and incidents to suggest rules, and by PagerDuty Advance generative summaries, AI-generated post-incident reviews, and SRE Agent troubleshooting suggestions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
